Fm. 2
G. 35m-11-32

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Special Branch
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY. File No. D. 5757 Date March 26, 1934）

Subject (in full) Arrest of Vendors of Indecent Postcards.

Made by ____ and Forwarded by D.S. McKeown.

Sir,
At 10.15 p.m. March 23 C.D.S. 96 arrested at the corner of Foochow and Shantung Roads two indecent picture hawkers named Wong King Yung (王金荣), a native of Ningpo, aged 35, and Wong Foh Ding (王福建), a Kompo man, aged 44 and seized 61 copies of indecent pictures.
The accused were arraigned at the Shanghai Special District Court on the morning of March 24 and were fined $200 each or to serve 100 days imprisonment. All the indecent pictures were confiscated.

D.S. McKeown.
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

发自 2
G. 35m-11-32

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特别科
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处中央特别科档案室。档案号 D. 5757 日期 1934年3月26日）

事由（全称）：逮捕贩卖淫秽明信片者。

由 ____ 制作，经 D.S. McKeown 转呈。

先生：
3月23日晚上10时15分，刑事侦缉警员第96号在福州路与山东路路口逮捕了两名贩卖淫秽图片的小贩，分别为宁波籍、35岁的王金荣（Wong King Yung），以及高邮籍（Kompo man）、44岁的王福建（Wong Foh Ding），并查获淫秽图片61张。
被告于3月24日上午在上海特区法院受审，各被处以罚款200元，或监禁100天。所有淫秽图片均被没收。

D.S. McKeown.
D. S.

特别科主管警官。
